en.hubeali: H 14655 – From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammaad Bin Usman who said: ‘Abu Baseer narrated to me by saying, ‘

I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying that: ‘A man who was miles away from Al-Medina, saw in his dream in which it was said to him, ‘Go and Pray over Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, for the Angels have performed his<sup>asws</sup> washing in Al-Baqi’e’. So the man went, and found Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> to have passed away’.
en.sarwar: 207. From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammaad Bin Usman who said: ‘Abu Baseer narrated to me by saying, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah (a.s.) saying that: ‘

A man who was miles away from Al-Medina, saw in his dream in which it was said to him, ‘Go and Pray over Abu Ja’far (a.s.), for the Angels have performed his (a.s.) washing in Al-Baqi’e’. So the man went, and found Abu Ja’far (a.s.) to have passed away’.
